name: Fankriss the Unyielding
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/fankriss.md. Wowhead's 4,496,850 HP is a 'Seasonal 40 Player' value, so HP here is a clock over 216 s, three 72 s stretches that each open with a hatchling wave (real kills run longer; hatchlings really come about every 60 s, first soon after the pull). ESTIMATES: the room is drawn from prose (main tunnel from the south, three side tunnels). Melee 1,000 per 2 s is higher than the wiki's 'light' because Mortal Wound's whole threat is what it does to healing: a 10,000 HP tank lives on passive healing (`healPerSecond` 600 for a player tank, 640 for the ghost) when freshly swapped and is lost if a player healer ignores him (140 per second of healing while a player heals, cut further by every stack), and Mortal Wound ticks every 8 s (estimate) so five stacks arrive at about 40 s. Mortal Wound is a `debuff` on the tank, -10% healing per stack (`healingMult` 0.9, linear in stacks), `maxStacks` 12, 20 s (DBM; Wowhead says 30 s and BigWigs 15 s, disagreement listed in the research), cast only while he is on the tank (`conditional: onPlayer`). One tank player cannot actually swap with another, so the swap copies the Kurinnaxx model: at about five stacks a `restWindow` debuff (`forbidAbilities`) means 'the other tank has him' for 20.5 s, then `targetSwitch` throws the boss to 'the raid' (`stationary: true` keeps him in place and he hits nobody meanwhile, a simplification: in reality the other tank is taking those hits). The tank then Taunts him back when the debuff ends. The ghost tank roles see the same empty 20.5 s window for the same reason; the real tanks' Mortal Wound stacks are not on the second tank at all. Taunting early is scored by `tauntedTooSoon`. Spawn of Fankriss are `killFirst` adds from three fixed spots on a timer (real timing is random; Era has no boss-mod timer, 'groups of one to three'), 20 s `lifetime` standing for the kill window. ENGINE GAP that matters: an add cannot deal damage, and nothing can fire when an add survives its timer, so the 20 s Berserk (the real one-shot) cannot threaten anyone. It appears as a `wormBerserk` `transition` marker on the timeline and in tips, and the DPS race is scored only through `attacksOffPriority` while a worm lives. Their ~2,000 cloth hits are not simulated. Hatchlings: 4 per tunnel at three tunnels as non-killable `adds`, the player off-tank holds the west tunnel's pack (`playerFrom`), ghost groups the others; the AoE-on-call rule is tips only because adds cannot be attacked unless flagged killable and the 'keep them alive for the tanks to hold' rule has no metric. Entangle: for non-tanks a `debuff` with `stun: 8` (`playerChance` 0.3, 350 per second for the hatchlings biting; ENGINE GAP: only the tank can be teleported, so non-tanks root where they stand). Entangle never takes the tank who holds him (cmangos emulator selects with `SELECT_FLAG_SKIP_TANK`; no other source says either way), so tanks are excluded. The ~8 room drones at the pull and the worms' Suppression Room spawn point are not modelled.

labels.text: Raid, in the main tunnel mouth

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Two tanks trade him. At about five Mortal Wounds the other tank takes over and you wait out the 20 seconds with your stacks falling off: press nothing, then Taunt him back the moment you are clean.

offtank.label: Hatchling tank
offtank.description: You own the west tunnel. Four hatchlings every wave: pick them up before they reach the raid and hold them at the tunnel mouth.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: On the boss, ready to drop everything for a worm. Worms first, always.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: From the tunnel mouth you reach everything. Worms first, always. Hatchlings wait for the tank's call.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Mortal Wound is about your heals. Top the tank before the stacks climb, and move to the new tank the moment the swap happens.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt him back when your stacks have fallen off. Never early: you will just keep stacking.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

mortalWound.label: Mortal Wound
mortalWound.tip: -10% healing received per stack, refreshed by each new one. Only the swap clears it.

restWindow.label: Waiting: your stacks are falling
restWindow.tip: You just swapped. Press nothing for 20 seconds, then Taunt.

swapOut.label: Tank swap: other tank taunts
swapOut.toast: Tank swap: the other tank Taunted. Step back and let your stacks fall.
swapOut.tip: At about five Mortal Wounds the other tank takes him. Stop hitting and wait the stacks out.

entangle.label: Entangle
entangle.tip: A random player is rooted for 8 seconds at a tunnel mouth, with hatchlings biting. Healers, watch for it.

hatchlings.label: Hatchling wave
hatchlings.tip: Four hatchlings per tunnel. Pick up your tunnel's pack.

worm1.label: Spawn of Fankriss
worm1.tip: A worm. Twenty seconds until it berserks. Everyone swaps to it now.

worm2.label: Spawn of Fankriss
worm2.tip: A worm. Twenty seconds until it berserks. Everyone swaps to it now.

worm3.label: Spawn of Fankriss
worm3.tip: A worm. Twenty seconds until it berserks. Everyone swaps to it now.

wormBerserk.label: Spawn of Fankriss: Berserk
wormBerserk.tip: Twenty seconds after a worm appears it berserks and starts one-shotting. If it is still alive now, the raid is losing someone.

expectations.label: Take him back when your stacks are gone
expectations.tip: The other tank has him while your Mortal Wounds fall off. Wait out the full window, then Taunt the moment you are clean.

expectations.label: Pick up your tunnel's hatchlings
expectations.tip: Four come out of your tunnel at each wave. Pick them up before they reach the raid.

expectations.label: Hold the pack at your tunnel
expectations.tip: Stay at the mouth of the west tunnel, between the hatchlings and the raid.

expectations.label: Stay in the tunnel mouth
expectations.tip: You are in range of the boss and all three worm spawns from there.

expectations.label: Worms before the boss, every time
expectations.tip: Twenty seconds after a worm spawns it berserks and one-shots whoever it reaches. Stop what you are doing and kill it.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: When the threat bar is in the red band, stop attacking until the tank is clear again.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Mortal Wound cuts healing by 10% a stack. A 5-stack tank is taking half healing for the rest of the window.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: At five stacks your heals are half as strong. Do not let him get low at five.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

attacksOffPriority.label: Attacks on the boss while a priority add lived
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

tauntedTooSoon.label: Taunted before your stacks fell off
tauntedTooSoon.tip: Wait out the full 20 seconds. Taunting early keeps your stacks on.

cues.notes: Taunt back after a swap once the stacks have fallen; pick up the hatchlings; heal when the tank drops low.

list.label: Taunt him back: your stacks are gone
list.tip: Taunt the moment the wait ends. A late Taunt hands the other tank another wave of stacks.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: At five stacks your heals are half strength. Do not let him sit low.

list.label: Pick up your tunnel
list.tip: Taunt them or stand on them.

drills.name: Stack count and swap
drills.description: Mortal Wound every 5 s and a swap every 32 s. Wait out the 20 s after each swap, then Taunt him back.

drills.name: Worm kill windows
drills.description: A worm spawns every 13 s somewhere around the boss. Swap to it the moment it spawns and kill it inside its 20 s.

drills.name: Pick up your tunnel
drills.description: A hatchling wave every 18 s. Pick up your pack before it reaches the raid.

drills.name: Healing through Mortal Wound
drills.description: Stacks every 4 s with a swap every 30 s. Heal ahead of the stacks while your heals get weaker.
